summary: Reviewed home A/B and pricing drafts against icp.md objections and tracking.md, and wrote 12 ranked changes plus a signup and trial-start spec (steps 0-4 with owner-decision branches). Top blockers: empty Pro card, unanswered card/post-trial question, no product proof; live-page audit is pending the domain.

experiments.hypothesis: On the winning home variant, a real product visual (client-link screenshot or clip) above the fold raises sign-up per visitor.
experiments.metric: sign_up per unique visitor; cta_click rate

experiments.hypothesis: Showing trial-end terms and the card statement on the signup screen raises pro sign_up to trial_started.

Apply the ranked changes; keep A and B differing only in the element under test (E-O8-1). Draft to outbox/landing/; publish approval needed. Do not start before decision 4 is answered.

alerts.title: Four owner answers gate the pricing and signup pages
alerts.detail: Pro contents (decision 4), card required at trial (decision 5), whether a free signup counts as a conversion (decision 12) and what happens when the trial ends. Without them the pricing page cannot ship and the CTA hierarchy cannot be set. Answer by Fri 2026-11-06.

alerts.title: UK subscription rules may apply to the trial
alerts.detail: K-d61ac4930b: draft UK rules, expected from 1 Jan 2027 but not yet confirmed, require pre-contract info, reminders after trials and online cancellation. Spec builds these in cheaply; lawyer to decide applicability.
